title: wg: room-policy-04 §5 strict subset forbids an all-hands child room
description: §5 (L533): child room participants must be a strict subset of the parent's, so a child room can never hold every parent participant (no #general / @everyone channel). Fix: allow a non-strict subset, or define the parent as the general room. Found by the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI comparison 2026-10-18.
